subtitle: Outdoor Distance and Ground Tone
tagline: Places a sound outdoors without a reverb tail: eight outdoor profiles shape distance, air, and ground colour with zero latency.

body.lead: TB Ambient makes a sound seem farther away and outdoors without adding a reverb tail. It shapes the direct sound the way distance, air, and the ground colour it in eight outdoor settings, from an open field and a forest to snow and concrete, and it works with zero latency.

body.p: Choose an outdoor `PROFILE`, set how far away the source is with `DISTANCE` and how high with `HEIGHT`, then shape the tone with `GROUND` and `CHARACTER`. `MIX` blends the processed tone with the dry input sample for sample; at 0% the dry signal comes back unchanged.

ul: Eight outdoor profiles: Open Field, Forest, Dry Asphalt, Damp Earth, Rocky Open, Coastal Air, Snowfield, Concrete Exterior
DISTANCE from 1 to 100 m: farther settings reduce level and high frequencies
HEIGHT from 0.2 to 5 m for the broad ground colour
GROUND and CHARACTER for the strength of the ground colour and of the profile's character
No delay, reflections, or tail, and zero latency
Smooth 20 ms crossfades when settings or profiles change
Pixel-art display with a background for each profile and a source/listener placement view
8 factory presets, user presets, undo, and redo

steps: DISTANCE and HEIGHT: level, air, ground colour

note.title: About this manual
text: This manual describes TB Ambient 1.0.0 for Windows (VST3). There is no macOS build at the time of writing.

ol: Insert TB Ambient on a dialogue, foley, instrument, or effects track. The defaults are the Forest profile, `DISTANCE` 15 m, `HEIGHT` 1.5 m, `GROUND` 50%, `CHARACTER` 60%, and `MIX` 100%.
Set `DISTANCE` {{6}} and `HEIGHT` {{7}}; the placement view {{3}} shows where the source sits.
Blend with `MIX` {{10}}. Add a separate reverb after TB Ambient if the scene also needs a tail.

body.p: TB Ambient has zero latency and produces no reflections or reverb tail. Changes to the settings and the profile are crossfaded over 20 ms.

The eight factory presets in the Profiles group, one for each outdoor profile, all use DISTANCE 15 m, HEIGHT 1.5 m, GROUND 50%, CHARACTER 60%, and MIX 100%. LOAD USER PRESET opens a preset file, and SAVE stores the current settings as a user preset and selects it. The name shows Custom after you edit a control. Loading a preset starts a new Undo baseline; Undo and Redo step through the control changes made after that.
Starting points for common jobs. Adjust them by ear.

recipes.title: Winter scene
steps: Compare with MIX at 70 to 90% to keep some clarity.

rows: That is by design: TB Ambient adds no reflections or tail. Use a reverb after it.

First public release: outdoor distance and ground-material tone without a reverb tail; eight outdoor profiles; level, air absorption, and ground colour that change together with distance and height; zero-sample latency, with MIX 0% returning the dry signal; an 8-bit pixel-art display whose background changes with each profile.
